items.name: prose
items.title: Prose
items.description: Long-form text container: measure-limited width, paragraph gap, heading scale, lists, blockquote, code, tables (keyboard-focusable scroll region) and underlined links. Korean and Japanese get their own line-breaking rules via :lang.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project. Inspired by the YoRHa UI aesthetic; no original fonts, logos or assets are included. v4 migration: the ProseTable scroll region is focusable (tabIndex 0) only while the table overflows; code that relied on it always being a tab stop must not. It exposes `data-slot="prose-table-scroll"` and `data-overflow`. In development a `<th>` without `scope` logs a console warning.
